notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4, Total Governmental Funds 2023 column). Taxes 59,908 split with the General Fund (p11) and Street Fund (p14) schedule rows (sum ties exactly); Intergovernmental - state 107,283 split with the same schedules (homestead, pro-rate and property tax credit out of state aid); Other 38,369 split with the fund schedules (General 23,078, Street 300, Public Trust 8,940, Community Improvement 1,525, Housing 2,001, Cemetery 1,025 + Medical Center 1,500). Fund balances in *_fund_balance; ending/beginning cash = Cash + cash held by county treasurer from p3 (2023 / 2022 columns), CDs and investments in *_investments; restricted cash and CDs (56,465 / 32,675) are combined and left out of both. Loan proceeds 40,000 in debt_proceeds (statement other financing); the Street Fund schedule prints them among revenues, so the detail line is a revenue line. Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (p6, 2023 Totals column), aligned with FY2024; measure cash (403,128 to 335,316, p7); no single total printed, receipts/disbursements totals computed (operating + nonoperating). Township taxes 477 recorded as property tax: the Statement of Activities property taxes 46,438 (p2) = general levy 43,119 + property tax credit 2,811 + township taxes 477 + 31. NPPD 6,821 stays In Lieu of Tax (budget schedule p10 prints it as In-lieu-of tax). Detail: per-fund schedules for every governmental fund (pp11-22); the combined all-funds budget schedule (p10) is not used (combined, superseded by fund schedules); no business-type statement lines added since the funds with their own schedules are the governmental ones (user 2026-10-28 rule). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p3, totals equal government-wide 863,906), business-type from the proprietary funds statement (p5); totals from p1.
